page.overview:
Who is Fugetsu Kisaburo?

Fugetsu Kisaburo is a swordsmith from the Wano Country who forged the Yakuza Kasen. He is a member of the Fugetsu Family.

Kisaburo is a master swordsmith, having forged one of the 12 Supreme Grade Blades.

At some point in the past, Kisaburo forged the Yakuza Kasen. The sword eventually made its way off Wano, ending up in the possession of Issho.
